usedFor: ClearCRM holds customers and proposals, and Calendly turns each into a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A fresh proposal is the moment to offer a call, and the booking link is ready to send.

watchOut: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM is polling on a time window, so links follow after a scheduled check.
